text:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning a coordinated lockfile + vendor bump tomorrow morning. Need a short quiet window to avoid churn in CI. Target window: 09:00–11:00 PT.

maria: Primary actions:
- update submodules (model-serving, runtime-shims)
- vendor bump: openssl -> 2.4.1, proto-gen -> 3.9.0
- regen yarn/pip lockfiles and smoke-run tests

maria: If you have an open PR that touches vendor/third_party or submodules, please either rebase & mark as ready by 08:30 PT or mark WIP and avoid merging during the window. I will queue the lockfile PRs and do the merges sequentially. cc @ajay @sami

ajay: Acknowledged. I own the model-serving submodule PR (WIP). I can finalize tests today and aim to have it ready by 07:45 PT. Ill ping here when it's green.

sami: I'll hold off on the runtime-shims change that modifies the vendor tree. Plan to rebase early.

kevin: Two requests: 1) can we do merges one at a time (submodule first, then vendor, then lockfiles)? 2) run preserved env smoke tests after each merge to catch breakages early. CI can run a quick smoke job.

maria: Yes to linear merges. My plan: submodule updates -> vendor bumps -> regenerate lockfiles -> final smoke. I'll kick off a manual smoke job after each step.

kevin: Also flagging flaky e2e on the infra branch — if that fails we should skip non-blocking e2e during the quiet window and just do the unit/smoke checks.

release-bot: Reminder: Release cutoff for this cycle is tomorrow 08:00 PT. Any changes touching public APIs must be approved before cutoff.

maria: Good catch, release-bot. None of the planned dep bumps change public APIs but well watch changelog notes.

elaine: For the changelog: please add a short entry for vendor bumps and note any security-related fixes for openssl. I can draft it once PRs are merged.

maria: Perfect — Elaine will own the changelog entry.

ajay: PR command snippet in case others need it:
```
git fetch origin && git checkout -b update/submodule-model-serving
# update submodule
cd third_party/model-serving && git pull origin main && cd -
# commit submodule pointer
git add third_party/model-serving && git commit -m "update model-serving submodule to main-2025-11-xx" && git push origin update/submodule-model-serving
```

maria: Vendor bump tips (for those touching vendor):
- update pinned version in deps/ and run vendorize script
- run `./scripts/regenerate-locks.sh` locally before pushing
- include `:smoke:` label to trigger manual smoke job quick-run

kevin: I'll monitor CI queue and gate merges if we get >3 flakes. If that happens, pause merges and dig in.

maria: Thanks all. If there are no objections, Ill post a final reminder at 07:30 PT and open the merge PRs at 09:00 PT.

sami: No objections from me.

ajay: Good to go.

maria: Final note — please avoid force-pushing to release branches during the window. We'll be careful with histories. :lock:
